ns2:section.sectionText: Section A - SELF-PACED OPTION - All students must register for the lecture (self-paced format, Section A). Students must attend orientation lecture August 24, 2005 at 12:30 pm in 228 Natural History Bldg. After orientation instruction is self-paced with structured readings, repeatable exams and quizzes. For this section there will be NO regular lectures but many reviews that will be held in Room 228 NHB on Thursdays at 12:30-2:00pm. Esmail Meisami, course instructor. Email is meisami@life.uiuc.edu.
